name: test_five_historical_compiler_holes_are_rejected_by_the_gate
source:
local type W = require("wow")
local function inspect(v: W.NumberLike, text: W.TextLike)
   if v then print("truth") end
   if v == nil then print("absent") end
   if (v == nil) then print("parenthesized") end
   if v is number then print(v + 1) end
   local keyed: {any: any} = {[v] = text}
   local scalar = v as number
   print(keyed, scalar)
end

name: test_same_value_guards_work_in_positive_early_return_and_short_circuit_paths
source:
local type W = require("wow")
local inspectable = canaccessvalue
local function inspect(v: W.NumberLike, other: W.NumberLike)
   if not canaccessvalue(v) then return end
   if issecretvalue(v) then return end
   if v is number and v == v then print(v + 1) end
   if inspectable(other) and not issecretvalue(other) and other is number then print(other + 1) end
   if canaccessallvalues(v, other) then print(v == other) end
   local kept = canaccessvalue(other) and other
   print(kept)
end

name: test_scalar_decoding_requires_access_publicness_and_shape
source:
local type W = require("wow")
local public = issecretvalue
local function f(v: W.NumberLike)
   if not canaccessvalue(v) then return end
   if public(v) ~= false then return end
   if not (v is number) then return end
   local ordinary: number = v
   local asserted = v as number
   local function deferred(): number return ordinary + 1 end
   print(deferred(), asserted)
end
